title: Can Synthetic Faces Undo the Damage of Dataset Bias To Face Recognition and Facial Landmark Detection?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmarks measure the performance of face recognition and facial landmark detection models, focusing on biases related to physical attributes like head pose, illumination, and identity.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of the study.
